name: Bridge Coherence Score Registry
purpose: Define analog-only coherence scores for comparing projection alignment without implying identity, source recovery, or unification.
no_unification_guardrail: no QM/GR unification, derivation, replacement, or physics claim; only analog projection behavior

metrics.definition: Measures the alignment of source-relation pointers between compared projections.
metrics.calculation: score based on trace-link identity and metadata consistency

metrics.definition: Quantifies the structural similarity between retained features in distinct domains.
metrics.calculation: set-theoretic similarity of normalized feature sets

metrics.definition: Evaluates whether the losses in one domain are consistent with the preserved features in the other (differential check).
metrics.calculation: cross-match of preserved vs lost features across domains

metrics.definition: Measures if compared projections share a consistent recoverability class or target context.
A composite score reflecting alignment while penalizing claims that drift toward identity or unification.
metrics.calculation: weighted sum of other scores minus identity_language_penalty

governance_rules.rule: Coherence scores are indicators of analog alignment, not source truth.
Score results cannot be used as theorem evidence for unification.

forbidden_claims: High coherence scores prove source identity.
Feature overlap derives shared physical laws.
Compatibility scores eliminate the need for conflict preservation.
